description: This file implements the cu_up_connection_manager class, managing CU-UP connections, including handling new connections, disconnections, and message forwarding in a 3GPP telecommunications context.

classes.name: cu_up_connection_manager::shared_cu_up_connection_context
classes.description: Holds shared context for a CU-UP connection, including connection state and message handling.

classes.name: cu_up_connection_manager::e1_gw_to_cu_cp_pdu_adapter
classes.description: Thread-safe notifier forwarding E1AP messages from E1 GW to CU-CP.

methods.name: connect_cu_up
methods.description: Associates a CU-UP index with the connection context and retrieves its message handler.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Checks if the CU-UP repository has been created for this connection.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Removes the CU-UP repository and notifies closure.

methods.name: handle_message
methods.description: Handles incoming E1AP messages from CU-UP.

methods.name: e1_gw_to_cu_cp_pdu_adapter
methods.description: Constructor, manages connection count, and message forwarding to CU-CP.

methods.name: on_new_message
methods.description: Dispatches received E1AP messages to CU-CP executor.

methods.name: cu_up_connection_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the connection manager with parameters.

methods.name: handle_new_cu_up_connection
methods.description: Handles new CU-UP connection requests, creating and attaching processors.

methods.name: handle_e1_gw_connection_closed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a CU-UP connection is closed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully stops all CU-UP connections and cleans up resources.
